test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

The culprit had been shot __from __the back by the police inspector.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the preposition** "from"** is incorrect and should be replaced.
 
• The appropriate preposition to use in this context is** "in"**, as in **"shot in the back".**
 
• Using "**in the back" **correctly describes **the location where the culprit was shot.**

Hence, the correct statement is **"*The culprit had been shot in the back by the police inspector*."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Careful selection of prepositions is essential for providing accurate descriptions and ensuring clarity in a sentence.
 
• Using the correct preposition enhances the specificity and correctness of the information conveyed.
